scope.authority: Explicit coordinator delegation of these ten active installation effect helpers; existing restore handoff only.

files.moduleResponsibility: Start retained document targets read-only, verify pinned runtime/catalog/native material without core activation.
files.reason: Retain fresh separate secrets, pinned internal network/image/mounts, current restore guard, original material/hash proof and uncertainty/no-retry receipts; normalize catalog consistently through IN-01.

files.moduleResponsibility: Promote exact read-only retained provider to new writable target while retaining old target stopped/disconnected.
files.reason: Retain hash-bound preparation/connection/gateway approval, fresh guard and exact material readback; correct conditional catalog order mismatch IN-01. No write/tool call/core activation asserted.

files.moduleResponsibility: Prepare native journal relocation authority into new private inactive outputs.
files.reason: Retain native parser/image ownership, exact role/hash inventory, bounded base64/native binding proof, current restore guard and retained partial outputs. No provider start or semantic journal translation.

files.moduleResponsibility: Import memory dump and gateway SQLite into explicit isolated empty pinned targets.
files.reason: Retain lineage/empty/current-writer checks, single PostgreSQL import transaction, exclusive new SQLite file, fresh guard and preserved uncertain partial-state receipt; no activation or automatic replay.

files.moduleResponsibility: Initialize fixed owner authority and start prepared fresh runtime in explicit dependency order.
files.reason: Retain exact prepared graph/image/DSN/lineage owner-token binding, private credentials, bounded health or pinned portless-process readiness and preserved failed resources. Readiness is not channel/model/owner acceptance.

files.moduleResponsibility: Start exact precreated restored gateway and authenticate preserved inventory readback.
files.reason: Retain immutable source SQLite/pinned image, explicitly allowed private+egress networks, mounted maintained startup/private files, current guard and exact inventories; no RPC/encrypted credential use/task resumption proof.

files.moduleResponsibility: Content-envelope role/hash validation over existing portable core plus external material.
files.reason: Retain exact inventory, nested identity-trusted core validation, two full hash passes, context-scoped immutable validation cache/deepcopy and exclusive manifest; source labels do not prove quiescence or restore authority.

files.moduleResponsibility: Held-root-transaction component recheck before existing restore release.
files.reason: Retain current restore/database/archive/target authority, fresh memory/native/provider readbacks and original hold identity; correct shared catalog canonicalization IN-01. Returned requirements are bound to performed checks, not uploaded receipt approval.

files.moduleResponsibility: Collect explicitly fenced database/gateway/native source snapshot to new private destination.
files.reason: Retain trusted live guard, source inode/time/content inventories, exclusive copy/fsync and completion receipt only after final guard. Only test imports confirmed in current AST map; no installed runtime consumer or quiescence proven merely from this utility name.

files.moduleResponsibility: Provision new persistent target resources, databases and schema only.
files.reason: Retain trusted pinned graph/service roles, unique invocation labels/new names, explicit mounts/DSN, dependency-fenced runtime, persisted resource receipt and retained partial resources. Preparation does not activate runtime or claim household usefulness.

finiteDecisions.title: Use one canonical tool-catalog ordering through prepared document connection, promotion and verification

evidence.fact: Preserved gateway catalog ordered by original_name before logical hash.
Live tool list sorted by name when catalog_gateway_id is selected.
Same provider live list compared as returned without corresponding sort.
Promoted provider live list again compared without corresponding sort.

finiteDecisions.condition: Provider returns identical valid tool definitions in a different order from preserved sorted gateway inventory. Read-only connection succeeds, but later promotion/verification can fail exact list hash after old target stopped/disconnected and new writable target started.
finiteDecisions.decision: Share the exact existing conditional catalog canonicalization across all three stages; preserve tool definitions, expected logical hash, no-retry partial-state receipts and existing transaction/guard boundary.
finiteDecisions.limit: Complete static source contradiction; no restore, provider request or runtime failure executed/measured.

connectionsToE32: B02: actual independent readback stays provider-owned; catalog/material verification does not imply physical or resumed task completion.
APP-03: shared operator capture helper remains existing component_evaluation dependency; existing neutral ownership decision, no new platform.
limitations: Review only; historical source approval does not authorize starting, writing, deleting or retrying targets. Existing held restore release remains authority.
No secret files, private conversation, protected fixtures or independent acceptance criteria read.
Development measured tokens/credits/tool-call totals unavailable; do not infer zero cost.
